sideA.text:
From this point on in the Legacy deck, draw cards, reading both sides, until you hit a Pause or Stop card.
Read Pause and Stop cards to find out when to start drawing again.
If you do not see Pause or Stop card, keep drawing.

sideB.text:
Our objectives follow.
This month we have 2 mandatory objectives.
Remember you can always check to see how many objectives you need to complete for a given month by checking the objective calendar on the board.

mechanics.whenRead: During the January setup draw, after 01-02. The two mandatory objective cards are the next two cards (01-04 and 01-05).
rules: From here, draw Legacy cards and read both sides until you hit a Pause or Stop. Those cards say when to start drawing again.
If you do not see a Pause or Stop card, keep drawing. The printed sentence has no 'a' before 'Pause or Stop card'.

Objective calendar shown on the card: header 'YEAR 71 OF THE FALL – 0'. Prologue column: 1 star, 36. January column (outlined in white): 2 stars, 36. February column: 2 stars, 33. A fourth column is cut off at the right edge; the visible month label begins with M and one star is visible. The supply number for that column is not on the card.
mechanics.notes: The earlier sentence does say 'until you hit a Pause or Stop card' (with 'a'). Only the last sentence omits 'a'.
